title: Operator Orientation Storyboard & Progressive Checklist for Console First-Run
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and deliver a storyboard-driven onboarding tour for first-run Console users (operator persona). This ticket covers the visual assets, microcopy variations, empty-state illustrations, progressive checklist mechanics, and handoff artifacts for engineering. Focus is on a lightweight, skippable tour with persistent checklist, contextual tips, and accessible animations. We aim to reduce time-to-first-success for new teams provisioning a model endpoint, and increase completion of the initial setup funnel by 20% in the release experiment.
design_assets: Figma: Console Onboarding Storyboard v3 - frames 01-18
Figma: Empty State Illustration Pack - operator-variant.svg
ux_notes: Primary persona: Platform operator setting up a first model route and monitoring dashboard.
Launch flow: Welcome card -> Quickstart checklist (3 tappable steps) -> Route creation shortcut -> Observability walkthrough -> Finish and optional tips.
Checklist behavior: persistent on left rail; each completed step shows timestamp and small success animation; user can collapse checklist; progress persisted per-org.
Empty states: three variants (no-routes, no-keys, no-telemetry) with tailored CTAs and annotated screenshots showing where to click.
Microcopy: provide concise task-oriented copy + optional helper text. Include variant A (action-first) and B (explain-first) for A/B test.
Accessibility: all animated elements must respect prefers-reduced-motion, color contrast >= AA, components labeled for screen readers.
Localization: reserve space for translations; design accounts for longer copy in FR/DE; no icon-dependent-only affordances.
Telemetry: fire events for tour_start, step_complete, checklist_collapsed, tour_skip, tour_complete. Map events to analytics schema in attachments.
Fallbacks: on private deployments where network isolation prevents inline assets, show text-only checklist with links to docs.
Timing: animations <= 300ms per step; auto-advance disabled by default; allow keyboard navigation (arrow/enter) and skip button.
Acceptance metrics: +20% funnel completion in 14-day experiment and <5% drop-off rate on route creation step.
QA pointers: test with account roles (owner, admin, viewer) to ensure CTA visibility rules are correct.

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: SVG assets blocked in air-gapped/private deployments. Mitigation: support inline SVG embedding and text-only fallbacks.
Risk: Long translations could break compact side rail. Mitigation: reserve 30% extra width and validate with pseudo-localization.
Risk: Checklist might be ignored if too prominent. Mitigation: run A/B test between prominent vs collapsed-by-default variants and measure engagement.
Risk: Animation causes CLS on small screens. Mitigation: use transform-based collapse and test on 320px widths.
